own_words: Tell us in your own words
reassure: Help is on the way. You are doing well.
handover: Read this to the ambulance team
tile_text_bites: The person was bitten or stung
emergency_body: Call 112 first. Then follow the steps while you wait.
show_steps: While you wait: show me what to do
not_verified: Not checked against the PDF yet
handover_button: Show summary for the ambulance team
child_text: Guidance for children and babies is not covered yet.
oos_title: Call 112 or go to the nearest hospital
oos_text: This app covers five situations: unconscious, heart attack, choking, bites and burns. For anything else, call 112 or go to the nearest hospital.
about_intro: This app helps an untrained person help an adult until the ambulance arrives. Every step comes from the guidelines below and shows its source.
disclaimer: Research demo, not medical advice. In an emergency, call 112.
error: Something went wrong. If this is an emergency, call 112 now.
urgency_emergency: This is an emergency. Call 112 if you have not already.
urgency_clinic: Go to a clinic or hospital today.
urgency_home: No emergency signs found. Call 112 if things get worse.
cpr_hint: Push down each time the circle grows.
situation_changed: The situation has changed. Now showing: {{name}}
steps_done_title: You did everything on the list.
fallback_title: We could not be sure what happened
mic_listening: Listening. Speak now, then check the text.
mic_note: Your browser turns speech into text and may use an online service. Check the text before you continue.
mic_denied: Microphone access is blocked. Allow it in your browser, or type instead.
mic_no_speech: We did not hear anything. Try again, or type instead.
mic_failed: Speaking is not working right now. Please type instead.
aid_timer_hint: Tap start when you begin. It counts down {{time}}.
aid_timer_running: Keep going. You can move to the next step; the timer keeps running.
aid_stopwatch_hint: Keep going until help arrives. This shows how long it has been.
aid_cycle_hint: Stop as soon as the object comes out. If they become unresponsive, start CPR.
aid_note_bite_time_hint: Tap when you know the time of the bite. The ambulance crew will ask for it.
aid_note_pick: Set the time of the bite
aid_note_in_summary: This is added to the handover summary.
aid_timer_running_short: Keep looking until the time is up.
mic_switched: Heard {{lang}}. Now listening in {{lang}}, keep speaking.
mic_switched_repeat: Heard {{lang}}. Now listening in {{lang}}: please say it again.
tts_auto_note: Steps are read one after another. On steps that take time, it waits for you to tap Done, next.
tts_tap_next: When you have done this, tap Done, next.
